verdicts.missing: The specification limits chat history and outbound data but leaves the sharing context for server-side record reads unspecified.

verdicts.quote: A user holding only the chat one can use the chat and cannot open or change the settings. A user holding the administer one can open and change the settings and read every conversation.

cannot see user A's conversations or messages through the chat panel, through a list view, through a report or through a SOQL query. Only user A, and administrators holding the administer permission set, can.
Salesforce forbids a callout after unsaved database changes in the same request, so the builder must order work so this holds.
verdicts.missing: The restriction on synchronous trigger callouts and the asynchronous design for making the callout are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: The key is entered through the credential storage (C-7), not among them. … The key is not in the deployed source … Searching the debug log of a full chat exchange for the key finds nothing.
verdicts.missing: The specification requires secret storage in Setup but leaves the Salesforce credential mechanism unnamed.

verdicts.quote: Salesforce allows at most 120 seconds for one callout and for all callouts in one request together … the synchronous response size is limited (6 MB heap)
verdicts.missing: The callout count per transaction and the CPU time limit are unspecified.

verdicts.missing: The panel receives the synchronous result. No notification or polling mechanism tells it that a separate job has finished.

verdicts.quote: the org has too many concurrent long-running requests … the panel shows a "could not send, try again" message, re-enables the input and keeps the typed text.
verdicts.missing: This handles Salesforce refusing a browser request. The async job capacity and the outcome of a failed enqueue are unspecified.

verdicts.quote: advising the user to contact their administrator … advising the user to try again later: (a) HTTP 429; (b) HTTP 408 or any 500 to 599; (c) the 100-second timeout
verdicts.missing: Server errors and timeouts share the same user guidance. The specification distinguishes their stored categories but leaves a distinct visible outcome for each unspecified.

the transcript shows the partial text with a visible note stating the answer was shortened … When xAI does not answer within 100 seconds the user sees a "try again later" failure
